# Geraldton Pest Quotes

> Pest control in Geraldton and nearby suburbs: termites, cockroaches, spiders, ants, rats and mice. Tell us the pest and get one free quote from a local operator.

Geraldton Pest Quotes (geraldtonpestcontrol.com) is a free pest control referral service, not a pest control company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, pest type, property type, then contact details) and the request goes to one licensed local pest management operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.

- Service: pest control, termite inspection and treatment, and pre-purchase timber pest inspection quotes
- Area: Geraldton, City of Greater Geraldton (WA), including Beresford, Bluff Point, Spalding, Sunset Beach, Tarcoola Beach, Mount Tarcoola, Wonthella, Rangeway, Utakarra, Karloo, Strathalbyn, Wandina, Woorree, Waggrakine, Drummond Cove, Glenfield, Cape Burney, Narngulu, Moonyoonooka, Walkaway
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job
- Licensing: In Western Australia, pest management businesses must be registered with the Department of Health, and treatments must be carried out by a licensed pest management technician under the Health (Pesticides) Regulations 2011. The technician's licence card lists endorsements, such as Commercial Domestic Pests or Termites and Timber pests, that show what they can treat.

- **What areas does Geraldton Pest Quotes cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take pest control quote requests from Geraldton and nearby areas, including Beresford, Bluff Point, Spalding, Sunset Beach, Tarcoola Beach, Mount Tarcoola, Wonthella, Rangeway, Utakarra, Karloo, Strathalbyn, Wandina, Woorree, Waggrakine, Drummond Cove, Glenfield, Cape Burney, Narngulu, Moonyoonooka, Walkaway. Our referral service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. Ask the operator whether they charge for travel to rural properties.
- **What pests can you help with in Geraldton?** Termite inspections and treatment, pre-purchase timber pest inspections, cockroaches, spiders, ants, rats and mice in Geraldton and nearby suburbs. Possum requests only go to an operator who says they hold the licence or permit needed.
- **What affects the price of pest control?** The pest, how widespread it is, the size and construction of the building, roof and subfloor access, and the treatment method. Termite work also depends on whether you need an inspection, a barrier, baiting or treatment of active termites. We don't publish prices. A local operator will quote for your job.
- **Who does the work?** Geraldton Pest Quotes is a free referral service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't carry out pest control. We pass your request to one local pest control operator, who quotes, does the work and holds the licence the job needs.
